# STORE - University of Staffordshire Online Repository

> > STORE is University of Staffordshire's open-access institutional repository for discovering, browsing, and accessing academic research outputs, theses, and scholarly publications.

STORE is built on the EPrints platform and serves as the central hub for the university's research dissemination and institutional memory. It aggregates publications across multiple schools and faculties including Business, Digital Technologies and Arts, Health and Social Care, Law and Policing, and Life Sciences.

## Core Repository Access

- [Welcome to STORE](https://eprints.staffs.ac.uk): Homepage for STORE, University of Staffordshire's open-access institutional repository
- [Browse Items](https://eprints.staffs.ac.uk/view): Main browse interface for searching and discovering items in STORE repository
- [About the Repository](https://eprints.staffs.ac.uk/information.html): Information about STORE repository, EPrints software, and University of Southampton

## Browse and Discover

- [Browse by Subject](https://eprints.staffs.ac.uk/view/subjects): Browse STORE items using JACS subject classification system
- [Browse by Author](https://eprints.staffs.ac.uk/view/creators): Alphabetical author directory for discovering researcher publications in STORE
- [Browse by Faculty and Year](https://eprints.staffs.ac.uk/view/divisions): Browse STORE items by university faculty and school divisions
- [Browse by Year](https://eprints.staffs.ac.uk/view/year): Browse repository items organized by publication year timeline
- [Browse by Thesis](https://eprints.staffs.ac.uk/view/thesis): Browse thesis collection in STORE institutional repository
- [Browse by University of Staffordshire Author](https://eprints.staffs.ac.uk/view/creators_id): Browse publications by University of Staffordshire affiliated authors

## Repository Tools and Analytics

- [Latest 20 Additions to STORE](https://eprints.staffs.ac.uk/cgi/latest_tool): Display of latest 20 items added to STORE repository
- [Statistics](https://eprints.staffs.ac.uk/cgi/stats/report): Repository statistics and download analytics for STORE
